discovery.title: OpenWrt on This Network
discovery.noWifi: Connect to your router's Wi-Fi, then scan again.
discovery.error: Couldn't read the phone's network settings.
discovery.nothingHint: Make sure the phone is on the router's Wi-Fi and LuCI is enabled on the router. If the router is on another subnet, scan that subnet or enter its address.
discovery.sideRouter: Your gateway isn't OpenWrt, but there is an OpenWrt device on this network — you may be using it as a side router.
discovery.manualHint: An IP address or host name, e.g. 192.168.1.1
discovery.rangeInvalid: Not a valid subnet, or larger than /22

login.title: Sign In
login.duplicate: This router has already been added
login.name: Name
login.passwordHint: The OpenWrt root password — the one you use for LuCI
login.savePasswordHint: Stored in the system keychain. If off, you'll enter it each time the app starts.
login.samePassword: Do these routers share a password?
login.httpWarning: This router uses HTTP, so the password crosses your network unencrypted.

trust.newBody: The router uses a self-signed certificate that the system can't verify. Check that the fingerprint below matches the router's (LuCI → System → Certificates, or openssl x509 -fingerprint -sha256). Once trusted, the app accepts only this certificate.
trust.changedBody: The router presented a different certificate from the one you trusted. That's expected after a reset or firmware upgrade; otherwise someone may be impersonating the router.
trust.subject: Subject
